massages.title: Massages
massages.blurb: Release the tension and find your calm again
massages.imageAlt: Therapist applying aromatic oil during a relaxing massage
massages.description: Our massages blend Swedish, deep-tissue and Eastern techniques with cold-pressed oils. We work in warm, quiet treatment rooms with heated tables and music chosen to match each rhythm.

facials.title: Facials
facials.blurb: Glowing skin starts with a deep breath
facials.imageAlt: Client receiving a facial mask applied with a brush
facials.description: We assess your skin before every facial to choose the right actives. We use natural Mexican skincare, paraben-free and cruelty-free, and finish with a face and scalp massage.

body-rituals.title: Body Rituals
body-rituals.imageAlt: Body ritual with fruit, flowers and oils on a Talavera tile floor
body-rituals.description: Rituals inspired by Mexican tradition: Colima salt, Tabasco cacao and local clay. We exfoliate, nourish and wrap the skin, then close with a warm shower and a seasonal herbal tea.

hydrotherapy.title: Hydrotherapy
hydrotherapy.blurb: Heat, steam and water to renew body and mind
hydrotherapy.imageAlt: Wooden sauna lit with warm light
hydrotherapy.description: Contrasting heat, steam and water to boost circulation and let the body unwind. Our temazcal is led by a certified guide, and the circuit can be combined with any other treatment.

relaxing-massage.name: Relaxing massage
relaxing-massage.description: Soft, flowing strokes that slow down the nervous system.

deep-tissue-massage.name: Deep-tissue massage
deep-tissue-massage.description: Slow, firm pressure on knots and chronic tension points.

hot-stone-massage.name: Hot stone massage
hot-stone-massage.description: Warm volcanic stones that relax the muscle before it is worked.

aromatherapy-massage.name: Aromatherapy massage
aromatherapy-massage.description: An essential-oil blend chosen with you for how you want to feel.

foot-reflexology.name: Foot reflexology
foot-reflexology.description: Pressure on reflex points in the feet to rebalance the whole body.

hydrating-facial.name: Hydrating facial
hydrating-facial.description: Cleansing, a hyaluronic acid mask and serum for plump, dewy skin.

deep-cleansing-facial.name: Deep-cleansing facial
deep-cleansing-facial.description: Steam, gentle extractions and a soothing mask for clear pores.

anti-aging-facial.name: Anti-aging facial
anti-aging-facial.description: Firming actives, gentle radiofrequency and kobido massage.

enzyme-peel.name: Enzyme peel
enzyme-peel.description: Papaya and pineapple enzyme exfoliation that won't irritate the skin.

sea-salt-scrub.name: Sea salt scrub
sea-salt-scrub.description: Colima salt with coconut oil to renew the skin from head to toe.

chocolate-wrap.name: Chocolate wrap
chocolate-wrap.description: Antioxidant cacao that nourishes the skin and awakens the senses.

seaweed-wrap.name: Seaweed wrap
seaweed-wrap.description: Mineral-rich seaweed that tones and reduces puffiness.

mud-detox-ritual.name: Mud detox ritual
mud-detox-ritual.description: Volcanic mud, herbal steam and a light massage to finish.

spa-circuit.name: Spa circuit
spa-circuit.description: Sauna, eucalyptus steam, contrast shower and a heated pool.

temazcal.name: Temazcal
temazcal.description: A traditional herbal steam bath, guided step by step.

flotation-bath.name: Flotation bath
flotation-bath.description: An Epsom salt tub in low light to float effortlessly.

banner.title: Everything that awaits you at Alma Serena
banner.imageAlt: Spa lounge area beside a pool surrounded by plants

page.intro: Every visit starts with a short consultation to learn how you're feeling and what you need. From there we adjust the pressure, scents and timing of each treatment. All of them include access to our relaxation areas before and after your session.

pool.title: Heated pool
pool.description: Water at 32 °C surrounded by gardens, open to every guest of the day.
pool.imageAlt: Pool lit at dusk next to a terrace with umbrellas

sauna.title: Sauna and steam
sauna.description: A cedarwood sauna and a steam room with eucalyptus and mint.
sauna.imageAlt: Wooden sauna lit with warm light

lounge.title: Relaxation lounge
lounge.description: Wide beds, blankets and quiet, for as long as you'd like to stay.
lounge.imageAlt: Rest room with a large bed, wood finishes and afternoon light

tea-bar.title: Tea bar
tea-bar.description: Local herbal teas, fruit water and healthy snacks at no cost.
tea-bar.imageAlt: Cup of herbal tea beside dried flowers and a palm leaf

locker-rooms.title: Full locker rooms
locker-rooms.description: Lockers, robes, sandals, showers and natural bath products.
locker-rooms.imageAlt: Rolled towel, soap dispenser, candle and tulips

parking.title: Parking
parking.description: Free parking for guests, with step-free access.
parking.imageAlt: Aerial view of a parking lot with cars

cta.title: Ready for your moment of calm?
cta.text: Choose your treatments and book in under a minute.
